title: Hal warns of 33 million volts

tellings.quote: The how was telling me that they knew the voltage was like 33 million volts in one of these things.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had many UFO encounters, recalls what a man he calls Hal told him sometime after 2007. According to Bledsoe, Hal said that people knew the voltage inside one of these objects was something like 33 million volts. If true, it would mean someone had measured the enormous power of these craft.
